## Overview

**Condo Price Analysis in Cambodia** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). ITC condo-for-sale study: price drivers, districts, and formal PDS project management.

## Background & Motivation

**Condo for Sale in Cambodia** — ITC AMS PDS 2022–2023 (Lecturer **CHAN Sophal**). Five-member group with formal project management sections in guideline.

Condo investment in Phnom Penh and provincial cities requires comparables adjusted for district, floor, and amenities—often buried in unstructured listings.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Project guideline: Condo for Sale in Cambodia*:**

- **Goal:** Analyze condo sale market—which units are most expensive and where; identify **price drivers**
- **Sections:** Objectives, scope, timeline, resources, risks/mitigation, approvals
- **Analytical flow:** EDA → modeling → conclusions aligned with condo-for-sale domain

## Data Collection & Preparation

Scraped condo sale listings across Cambodian markets (see team notebooks/reports).

## Methodology & Analysis

Clean listing fields; visualize price by district and unit attributes; regression or tree models for sale price; geographic breakdown of premium segments.

## Model Evaluation

Model error on hold-out listings; map/visual summary of expensive districts.

## Results & Key Learnings

Investor-oriented view of condo price drivers and top-tier districts.
